title: Using recycled R1 water for irrigation and firefighting
summary: Since the 2023 fires, county workers, the fire chief and council members have pushed to use more R1 recycled wastewater. Fire officials said the main limit is a lack of delivery pipes. The county wants to use all of its reclaimed water for irrigation, needs to build pipes to deliver it, and has a Kāʻanapali R1 system 80 percent built.

timeline.text: A council member said the County needs to build out pipes to deliver this reclaimed water.
The member said reclaimed water use fell from 5 million to about 3 million gallons a day after the fire.
